mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", current_revision AS "currentRevision", published_revision AS "publishedRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_data_state WHERE game_id = #{gameId} LIMIT 1

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", current_revision AS "currentRevision", published_revision AS "publishedRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_data_state WHERE game_id = #{gameId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.game_data_state (game_id, current_revision, published_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, 0, 0, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO NOTHING
